\begin{example} \end{example}[Nonlinear Wave Equations]

↗ def:kth-order-pde ↗ def:linear-semilinear-quasilinear-fully-nonlinear

1. ch1:1.2.1.b.11\group Examples of PDE

\[ u_{tt} - \Delta u = f(u), \] \[ u_{tt} - \Div \, \mathbf{a}(Du) = 0. \] The reaction form is second-order semilinear. For classical solutions, the divergence form is equivalent to \[ u_{tt} - \sum _{i,j}\frac{\partial a_j}{\partial p_i}(Du)u_{x_i x_j} = 0, \] and is second-order quasilinear. \end{example}
